rules.spilled-result: Claude Code persisted-output wrapper naming a tool-results file; charged to the producing call.
rules.spill-filter-followup: Consecutive read-only calls with split/filter/slice/includes/match after a spilled result, ending at input or an unknown call.
rules.nonexistent-method: An error result contains is not a function or is not defined.
rules.refused-tool: An error result says No such tool available or a tool is disabled for this session.
rules.wait-after-save: waitFor in a Cmd+S call or the next call; the entire call is charged.
rules.split-menu-click: One click opens an observed menu and the next call clicks an observed item in that menu; charged to the second call.
rules.saved-unconfirmed-read: Read-only call immediately after a result containing saved: not confirmed.
rules.consecutive-read: Read-only call immediately after a read-only call, excluding failed calls.
rules.lease-or-guard-refusal: Error result contains Input lease, nothing from this call ran, or sleight stopped before.
rules.preliminary-inventory: Read-only getState/listApps call followed immediately by getApp; charged to the inventory call.
rules.explicit-delay: Call contains setTimeout or sleep; the entire call is charged.

accounting: Attributed seconds = gap before the call + call wall time. Gaps include model and host scheduling, not isolated model API time. Classes overlap. Unique counts each classified call once. Unknown times are null and omitted from seconds. Parallel call walls can overlap.
